title: Video tutorials
body:
It would be incredibly helpful to include short video tutorials showing how to make the most of the app. Many children with ADHD, like my son, also have dyslexia, and step-by-step visual guidance would give them much more independence and confidence using the platform.

With AI, this app has the potential to become a true tutor available in multiple languages. Being neurodivergent is not easy, and for children it can sometimes feel overwhelming. Supporting autonomy and accessibility can make a real difference in their daily lives.
author: XANA—1971

title: The AI doesn’t work
body: I payed the full version for a year trusting on Editor’s choice award app, but I must say is one of the worst chatbots that I ever use. I ask very simple tasks and still doesn’t deliver.

title: app overheat phone very laggy
body: I appreciate many app’s features, especially timeline, however the app is very unresponsive on my iphone 11 max pro. Also, it would be great to have habits tracker and statistics. Other apps provide more value for this price.
author: Vildnjxjdnenf

title: Que deceção
body:
Desde o AI por voz funcionar mal com respostas que não correspondem as minhas perguntas, fazer tasks sem sentido e horarios impossiveis. Para alem de nao perceber nada do que digo em portugues.
Foi rapido ate encontrar um bug em que ao registar uma tarefa e tentar ajustar o timing, vai buscar o espaco sem as novas tarefas criadas o que deixa de fazer sentido.
E ser impossivel sincronizar o calendário do iphone mesmo tendo conta paga, esta app é uma decepção.
